nodes.name: Fashion
nodes.description: The design, production, and culture of clothing and personal adornment.

nodes.name: Fashion Design
nodes.description: The creative design of clothing and accessories.

nodes.name: Haute Couture
nodes.description: Exclusive made-to-measure high fashion of the Parisian houses.

nodes.name: Ready-to-Wear
nodes.description: Factory-produced designer clothing in standard sizes.

nodes.name: Bespoke Tailoring
nodes.description: Custom tailoring of garments to an individual client.

nodes.name: Sustainable Fashion
nodes.description: Fashion designed to minimize environmental and social harm.

nodes.name: Streetwear Design
nodes.description: Design of casual, youth-oriented clothing rooted in urban subcultures.

nodes.name: Garments
nodes.description: Articles of clothing worn on the body.

nodes.name: Dress
nodes.description: A one-piece garment covering the body, typically worn by women.

nodes.name: Suit
nodes.description: A matched set of jacket and trousers or skirt.

nodes.name: Coat
nodes.description: A long outer garment for warmth.

nodes.name: Jacket
nodes.description: A short outer garment for the upper body.

nodes.name: Trousers
nodes.description: A garment covering the lower body with separate legs.

nodes.name: Skirt
nodes.description: A garment hanging from the waist.

nodes.name: Shirt
nodes.description: An upper-body garment with collar and sleeves.

nodes.name: Knitwear
nodes.description: Garments made by knitting yarn, such as sweaters.

nodes.name: Sportswear
nodes.description: Clothing designed for athletic activity.

nodes.name: Outerwear
nodes.description: Garments worn as the outermost layer for weather protection.

nodes.name: Formal Wear
nodes.description: Clothing for ceremonies and formal occasions.

nodes.name: Footwear
nodes.description: Items worn on the feet, from shoes to boots.

nodes.name: Shoe
nodes.description: Footwear covering the foot, typically below the ankle.

nodes.name: Boot
nodes.description: Footwear extending above the ankle.

nodes.name: High Heel
nodes.description: Footwear with a raised heel, historically gendered.

nodes.name: Sneaker
nodes.description: Casual athletic-style shoe, a major fashion object.

nodes.name: Fashion Accessories
nodes.description: Items worn to complement clothing.

nodes.name: Handbag
nodes.description: A carried bag, central to fashion branding.

nodes.name: Hat
nodes.description: A head covering worn for fashion or function.

nodes.name: Scarf
nodes.description: A length of fabric worn around the neck or head.

nodes.name: Belt
nodes.description: A band worn around the waist.

nodes.name: Eyewear
nodes.description: Spectacles and sunglasses as fashion items.

nodes.name: Fashion Styles
nodes.description: Historical and subcultural styles of dress.

nodes.name: Victorian Fashion
nodes.description: 19th-century British dress of corsets, crinolines, and formality.

nodes.name: Flapper Style
nodes.description: 1920s dress of dropped waists and short hems expressing liberation.

nodes.name: Punk Fashion
nodes.description: DIY anti-establishment style of the late 1970s.

nodes.name: Hippie Fashion
nodes.description: 1960s countercultural dress of loose, natural, colorful garments.

nodes.name: Grunge Fashion
nodes.description: 1990s anti-fashion of flannel, layers, and thrift.

nodes.name: Streetwear
nodes.description: Casual urban fashion rooted in skate, hip-hop, and sneaker culture.

nodes.name: Athleisure
nodes.description: Athletic clothing worn as everyday fashion.

nodes.name: Genderless Fashion
nodes.description: Fashion dissolving traditional gender categories.

nodes.name: Fashion History
nodes.description: The historical study of dress and its social meanings.

nodes.name: Costume Design
nodes.description: Design of clothing for film, theater, and performance.
